I don't use an online store. When a piece is available, I sell it directly.

To buy a piece, email me at lisa@lisamayceramics.com and tell me which one caught your eye. I'll confirm it's still available, and we'll sort out payment (Venmo works well) and shipping or pickup. Shipping depends on where you are and how much packing a piece needs — I'll get you a real number before anything is final.

Pieces are one of a kind and sold as marked; I update them as soon as they're spoken for. Like something that's already spoken for? I'm happy to make another in the same spirit — email me.
